description: Build geometry from a computational design document or a template. New part: search_design_library, then create_design_preview. CPU job, not charged: usually under a minute for a part, several for a detailed assembly. To test parameter changes, run one study through call_design_operation, not a build per variation. Not for editing an uploaded CAD file (use reconstruct_cad and edit_reconstructed_cad). Build one template_id or self-contained gd.design/v1 document. Document assets/imported CAD references are unsupported; never drop them. STL/design defaults; exact STEP only when the user asks for CAD and every exported feature supports it. For meshing implicit multizone geometry, purpose=meshing, method=auto and explicit output_names permit checked named faceted STEP volumes. Heatmaps and boundary patches are not volume regions; artifact metadata records exact versus faceted geometry. Returns the job ID, waiting briefly for the viewer; continue a longer build with get_design_preview. Does not approve the design or edit Studio projects. Then end your reply with the viewer_url, unasked, opened in the chat's browser; no STL, STEP, design JSON or job links unless asked. May incur compute charges.

design_brief_artifact_id.description: Immutable owned design brief used to derive this candidate; retained in job lineage

document.description: Self-contained gd.design/v1 document, up to 1 MiB, of general operations and library blocks (search_design_library); `blocks` {name: edition} copies blocks in. Not with template_id; no assets or external references. The worker checks validity, manufacturing and exact export.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each new job, even with identical inputs or a matching finished job. Reuse it unchanged only to retry or resume that same intended job, an uncertain submission included.

method.description: Exact STEP by default. For purpose=meshing, auto permits checked faceted STEP for implicit volumes; artifacts record the actual representation.

named_stl.description: Also export each selected document body as a separate named STL, alongside the combined surface, for mesh wall patches.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL sent a signed notification when the job finishes, so you need not poll.

purpose.description: Meshing requires explicit volume output_names; heatmaps, boundary patches and display helpers are rejected by the geometry engine.

template_id.description: Registered template; mutually exclusive with document

name: create_geometry
title: Build geometry
